description: Ten evidence-led checks for understanding what AI work touched, changed, remembered, and actually completed.

defaultPrompt: Check whether this agent task actually finished.
Review this material before I share it with AI.

interface.longDescription: Ten local-first checks for consequential AI work. Trace where data moved, review what an agent can remember, compare AI drafts with accepted work, right-size agent access, diagnose failed runs, and verify claimed outcomes against durable systems of record. Every check separates evidence from inference, preserves unknowns, and ends with a visible completion criterion.

name: oximy-reality-checks
